entries.excerpt: I'm a big fan of the BBC podcast In Our Time -- and (like most people) I've been playing with the OpenAI APIs. entries.guide_zh: 借助 GPT 按杜威分类整理 BBC《In Our Time》，让近千集节目更好查找。

entries.title: Show HN: ChatLLaMA – A ChatGPT style chatbot for Facebook's LLaMA
entries.author: aaronrelph
entries.current_title: Show HN: ChatLLaMA – A ChatGPT style chatbot for Facebook's LLaMA
entries.excerpt: ChatLLaMA is an experimental chatbot interface for interacting with variants of Facebook's LLaMA. Currently, we support the 7 billion parameter variant that was fine-tuned on the Alpaca dataset. This early versions isn't as conversational as we'd like, but over the next week or so, we're planning on adding support for the 30 billion parameter variant, another variant fine-tuned on LAION's OpenAssistant dataset and more as we explore what this model is capable of. entries.guide_zh: ChatLLaMA 为 LLaMA 变体提供聊天界面，作者说明目前仍是早期实验。

entries.title: Show HN: GPT Repo Loader – load entire code repos into GPT prompts
entries.author: mpoon
entries.current_title: Show HN: GPT Repo Loader – load entire code repos into GPT prompts
entries.excerpt: I was getting tired of copy/pasting reams of code into GPT-4 to give it context before I asked it to help me, so I started this small tool. In a nutshell, gpt-repository-loader will spit out file paths and file contents in a prompt-friendly format. You can also use .gptignore to ignore files/folders that are irrelevant to your prompt. gpt-repository-loader as-is works pretty well in helping me achieve better responses. entries.guide_zh: GPT Repo Loader 将代码仓库整理成提示词友好的路径和内容格式。
